description: PB-36 is the official RTO code for Phagwara, functioning as a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office under the Punjab Transport Department. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and road tax collection for the Phagwara sub-division in Kapurthala district.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Phagwara, District Kapurthala, Punjab
